The Ten Purifications Wheel spins automatically, assimilating every type of attack received until reaching TOTAL IMMUNITY. The more attacks you receive, the stronger you become. Adaptation is inevitable.

en.A técnica suprema de Rengoku. Dragões de: Rengoku's ultimate technique. Flame dragons that incinerate everything.
en.A técnica suprema de Rengoku. Golpes que: Rengoku's ultimate technique. Strikes that unleash flame dragons.
en.A técnica suprema do Espadachim Negro co: The Black Swordsman's ultimate technique as the Star King of Underworld. Using Incarnation and the dual wielding of Night Sky Sword and Blue Rose Sword, he distorts the very reality of combat.
The Flame Hashira's ultimate technique. A series of explosive strikes that incinerate the target.
en.A técnica ápice do Infinito: fusão perfe: The pinnacle technique of the Infinity: a perfect fusion of Blue and Red that creates a void that erases everything from the battlefield. Ignores any of the target's defenses.
en.A técnica única de Mitsuri Kanroji. Com: Mitsuri Kanroji's unique technique. With muscles eight times denser than normal, her flexible blade creates attacks impossible to predict.
en.A técnica única de Shinobu Kocho. Como n: Shinobu Kocho's unique technique. Since she doesn't have the strength to decapitate, she uses deadly poison injected through the blade.

en.A veste de um feiticeiro reencarnado. Of: The robe of a reincarnated sorcerer. Offers balance and continuous regeneration in battle.
en.A veste do Assassino de Feiticeiros — To: The Sorcerer Killer's robe — Toji Fushiguro. Toji never forgives the first mistake: the first strike of the battle deals +75% extra damage. Heavenly Restriction Event reward.
en.A única Hashira que não consegue decapit: The only Hashira who can't decapitate demons by force. But her ultra-concentrated wisteria poison can kill even Upper Moons. Her dance looks gentle — until you realize you've been poisoned.

en.A Anjo expande o Paraíso Proibido — um d: The Angel expands the Forbidden Paradise — a domain of absolute light where every curse is extinguished. For 3 turns: takes 60% less damage, regenerates 40 HP per turn, and unleashes a Divine Judgment of 50 additional damage each turn. Upon expiration, all absorbed energy is released as a devastating burst of light at the enemy.
en.A Arte Demoníaca de Gyutaro e Daki. Uma: Gyutaro and Daki's Demonic Art. An inseparable deadly duo; victory only comes when both fall.
en.A Arte Demoníaca de Rui, o Lua Inferior: Rui's Demonic Art, the Lower Moon 5. Uses incredibly tough and sharp threads like steel to slice enemies apart.
en.A Bola Bijuu em escala máxima — o ataque: The Bijuu Ball at maximum scale — Kurama's most destructive attack. The explosion wipes out everything within kilometers.
en.A Ferramenta Amaldiçoada Especial de trê: The Special Cursed Tool with three sections used by Toji Fushiguro and Maki Zenin.
en.A Grade me enviou para me capturar? Que: The Grade sent me to capture myself? What an insult!
en.A Grade me expulsou... agora vou arranca: The Grade expelled me... now I'm going to rip from you everything it has of value.
en.A Hashira com músculos oito vezes mais d: The Hashira with muscles eight times denser than a normal human's. Her unique flexible blade and her Love Breathing create attacks impossible to predict — like feeling itself.
en.A Lança que neutraliza qualquer técnica: The spear that neutralizes any cursed technique at the point of contact.
en.A Logia do Relâmpago dominada pelo Ser D: The Lightning Logia mastered by the Divine Being, Enel. The user becomes pure electricity. All attacks hit in an area. With each strike, 'Divine Voltage' increases, unleashing catastrophic effects and ignoring conventional defenses.
en.A Lua Superior 4. Covarde na base, mas q: The Upper Moon 4. Cowardly at the core, but when cornered, physically manifests his darkest emotions.
en.A Nuvem Lúdica é uma ferramenta de três: The Playful Cloud is a three-section tool linked by chains. The user unleashes a devastating triple strike.
en.Uma joia misteriousa que amplifica o pod: A mysterious jewel that amplifies the destructive power of all attacks. Supreme critical guaranteed.
en.Uma lança de ferro magnetizado atravessa: A magnetized iron spear pierces barriers and deals extra damage against shields.
en.Uma lâmina forjada artesanalmente com me: A hand-forged blade made with basic metal and residual cursed energy. Good for beginners.
en.Uma máscara de osso nascida da corrupção: A bone mask born from spiritual corruption. Grants brutal power, dramatically increasing attack when health is low.
en.Uma pequena contenção mágica que enfraqu: A small magical seal that weakens the target's energy. -10% energy regeneration for 2 turns.
en.Uma picada no ponto vital com veneno let: A strike to the vital point with concentrated lethal poison.
en.Uma picada precisa no ponto vital que en: A precise strike to the vital point that severely poisons.
en.Uma picada precisa que injeta veneno e r: A precise strike that injects poison and reduces regeneration.
en.Uma pirâmide de ferro comprime o alvo, q: An iron pyramid crushes the target, breaking shields and accumulated defense.
en.Uma quimera de Gama e Orochi. Paralisa i: A chimera of Gama and Orochi. Paralyzes enemies and deals poison damage.
en.Uma rajada de magia ofensiva precisa e i: A precise and unavoidable burst of offensive magic. If the target is under a debuff: damage increased by +10%.
en.Uma rajada massiva e negra que oblitera: A massive black burst that obliterates defenses.
en.Uma rede de fios que prende e lacerama o: A web of threads that traps and gradually lacerates the target.
en.Uma sequência curta e brutal que cauteri: A short and brutal sequence that cauterizes wounds. Reduces the target's healing for 3 turns and heals Tanjiro for 10% of max HP if below 35%.
en.Uma sequência de cortes em alta velocida: A sequence of high-speed cuts that applies Demon Marks. Each mark increases critical damage by +15% (max 5).
en.Uma sequência de golpes rápidos da Lança: A sequence of rapid strikes from the Inverted Spear of Heaven.
en.Uma sequência frenética de golpes que at: A frantic sequence of blows that hits all vital points.
en.Uma série de cortes que caem como gotas: A series of cuts that fall like raindrops.
en.Uma série de cortes que imitam a rotação: A series of cuts that mimic the rotation of a hurricane.
en.Uma série de golpes em pontos vitais que: A series of vital-point strikes that destroy the body's structure.
en.Uma série de golpes em redemoinho inesqu: A series of blows in an unforgettable whirl.
en.Uma série de golpes em redemoinho que nã: A series of blows in a whirl that leaves no opening.
en.Uma série de golpes em ritmo acelerado q: A series of blows at a rapid rhythm that leaves no room for defense.
en.Uma série de golpes em ritmo que não dá: A series of blows in rhythm that leaves no room for defense.
en.Uma série furiosa de cortes que não dá c: A furious series of slashes that gives no chance to defend.
en.Uma teia rotativa absurdamente resistent: A ridiculously durable rotating web launched at high speed.
en.Uma tempestade de gelo que cobre todo o: A blizzard of ice that covers the entire field in deadly crystals.
en.Uma tempestade de pó de ouro sela, corta: A storm of golden dust seals, cuts resources, and converts part of defense into damage.
en.Uma técnica de corte que penetra qualque: A cutting technique that pierces any defense — barriers, shields, and armor cannot withstand the King's power.
en.Uma versão aprimorada da técnica de Ban,: An enhanced version of Ban's technique, draining massive energy.
en.Uma versão aprimorada do Azul que distor: An enhanced version of Azul that distorts space at multiple points, attracting and crushing enemies with absolute centripetal force. Reduces targets' dodge by 60%.
en.Uraume concentra energia maldita nas mão: Uraume concentrates cursed energy in their hands and fires a high-speed spear of pure ice. The impact leaves crystals of energy scattered across the target's body — each Spear applies **1 Crystallization** (max 6). Each active stack grants +10% ice damage on all attacks. Uraume's ice does not merely wound — it accumulates, until the final explosion.
en.Uraume cristaliza o solo ao seu redor cr: Uraume crystallizes the ground around them, creating a slick field of cursed ice. For **3 turns**, has a **25% chance to completely dodge** any attack. Upon dodging, instantly slides to the opponent's blind spot and delivers a **counterattack of 35 damage + 1 Crystallization stack**. The ice does not merely defend — it redirects.
en.Uraume desencadeia uma nevasca de energi: Uraume unleashes a blizzard of cursed energy that sweeps across the entire area. Deals direct damage and applies **2 Crystallization stacks**. In addition, partially freezes the enemy for **3 turns**: −**30% attack** and −**20% defense**. While Partial Freeze is active, Uraume heals **+20 HP for each attack that lands**. The blizzard does not merely hurt — it weakens and drains.
en.Uraume detona simultaneamente todos os c: Uraume detonates all crystals accumulated on the enemy's body at once in an explosion of absolute cold. Deals **90 + (stacks × 65)** damage — with 6 stacks: **+390 extra**. The hit is guaranteed and causes **stun**. The explosion also leaves deep ice cracks on the enemy: −**40% defense for 2 turns** (Ice Crack). When the ice explodes, there is no escape.
en.Uraume entra em estado de colapso térmic: Uraume enters a thermal collapse state and releases total control of their ice technique. For **4 turns**: all attacks deal **+50% damage**, each hit automatically applies **1 Crystallization stack**, and a trail of cursed ice covers the field dealing **25 damage per turn** to the enemy. Upon activation, it already applies 1 stack immediately. Winter's Fury is not rage — it is absolute freezing precision.
en.Uraume expande seu Domínio — a Tormenta: Uraume expands their Domain — Eternal Storm, a dimension of perpetual cursed ice storm where the temperature drops below absolute zero. For **4 turns**: deals **+100 ice damage per turn**, all attacks have **guaranteed crits**, each application of Crystallization applies **3× stacks** instead of 1. When it expires: **all accumulated stacks detonate simultaneously** dealing **+80 damage per stack**. Uraume's Domain is the storm that never ends.
en.No Modo Sennin, Naruto percebe todo o ch: In Sennin Mode, Naruto senses all the chakra around him. +50 defense, recovers 30 HP and +30% evasion on the next turn.
en.No começo da rodada, aumenta o dano de s: At the start of the round, increases allies' sword skill damage by 30% for 2 turns (Raid).
en.Nobara crava pregos imbuídos com Energia: Nobara drives nails imbued with Cursed Energy into the enemy through a straw doll, transmitting damage from a distance.

en.Nos 2 primeiros turnos, reduz 10% do dan: For the first 2 turns, reduces damage taken by 10%.
en.Nos 3 primeiros turnos, reduz 15% do dan: For the first 3 turns, reduces damage taken by 15%.
en.Notável... um feiticeiro que pode derrot: Impressive... a sorcerer who can defeat a Grade 1... you will be watched.
en.Novo núcleo Fractal da Alma (0-300): cad: New Soul Fractal core (0-300): each skill generates Fragments, Rupture, and Echo. Upon reaching thresholds (90/180/300), it unlocks stages with distinct bonuses (control, execution, and collapse). At 300, activates Idle Singularity for 2 turns: ignores 35% of defense, converts 20% of damage into healing, and replicates 1 status effect on the main target to secondary targets. Works in all modes: combat, raid, and global boss.
en.Não me venha com papo. Vou te mostrar o: Don’t come at me with that talk. I’ll show you what it means to face a real Hashira!
en.Não merece estar diante de mim. Mas... m: You don’t deserve to stand before me. But... I’ll show you the power of the Serpent.
en.Não tenho inimigos — só adversários que: I don’t have enemies — only opponents I need to surpass! But I won’t hold back!
en.Não... ainda... com fome... tão... famin: No... not... yet... hungry... so... hungry...
en.O Caçador canaliza todo o treinamento em: The Hunter channels all training into one decisive blow, aiming for the Demon’s neck with surgical precision.
en.O Chefe dos Sapos de Monte Myoboku é inv: The Chief Toad of Mount Myoboku is summoned. Gamabunta crushes enemies with his colossal weight and giant sword.
en.O Domínio Expandido de Satoru Gojo. O in: Satoru Gojo’s Expansion Domain. The enemy is trapped in the Unlimited Void — overwhelmed with infinite information and unable to resist. Ignores all defense and drains the target’s energy.
en.O Domínio Expandido definitivo: manifest: The ultimate Expansion Domain: manifests the internal reality where all transfiguration is infallible.
en.O Domínio Expandido despertado: um tribu: The awakened Expansion Domain: an inescapable courtroom that declares every enemy in the area GUILTY, instantly drains 80% of stamina, and for 4 turns enemies lose 25% stamina/turn. The user deals +60% damage and takes 40% less damage during the Trial.
en.O Domínio de Higuruma: um tribunal inesc: Higuruma’s Domain: an inescapable courtroom where the Judge processes the opponent instantly, declaring them GUILTY, confiscating their stamina, and executing the Death Penalty in sequence.
en.O Domínio definitivo de Kashimo — uma te: Kashimo’s ultimate Domain — a lightning storm that swallows the entire world. For 5 turns: guaranteed crits, +60% damage, 70 lightning damage per turn, and 20 HP regen. When it ends: an explosion of all accumulated electricity WITH additional 30-damage lightning for each remaining Electric Charge. Primordial nature judges all.
en.O Flash Negro definitivo que destrói tud: The ultimate Black Flash that destroys everything within the impact radius.
en.O General avança com toda a força da Rod: The General advances with the full force of the Wheel — the impact is so brutal it stuns any target regardless of resistance.
en.O General manifesta a Roda em seu ápice: The General manifests the Wheel at its absolute peak — a divine explosion that crushes everything in range. Ignores all defense and stuns the survivors.
en.O General projeta a Roda Sagrada em alta: The General launches the Sacred Wheel at high speed toward the target. Fast and cutting — the base skill of one who carries the General’s spirit.
en.O Genjutsu supremo do Mangekyou. Em fraç: The Mangekyou’s supreme Genjutsu. In a fraction of a second, the target experiences 72 hours of mental torture — wakes up completely paralyzed.
en.O Hashira da Água de poucas palavras e p: The Water Hashira of few words and immense power. Tomioka alone created the Eleventh Form of Water Breathing — a feat no one else achieved.
en.O Hashira de Chama de espírito inabaláve: The Flame Hashira with an unshakable spirit. Rengoku shines like an eternal flame, with a heart that never retreats. His Fire Breathing burns everything in its path.
en.O Hashira de olhos bicolores e sua serpe: The Hashira with heterochromatic eyes and his white snake Kaburamaru. His twisted blade moves like a snake, striking from angles that defy physics. Merciless toward demons.
en.O Hashira mais agressivo e brutal. Seu c: The most aggressive and brutal Hashira. His body covered in scars tells the story of countless battles. His mutant blood attracts and drives demons mad — something he uses as a weapon.
en.O Hashira mais flamboyant e extravagante: The most flamboyant and extravagant Hashira. A former top-class ninja, Tengen analyzes combat like a musical score and attacks at the exact beat of the rest.
en.O Hashira mais forte de toda a história: The strongest Hashira in all modern history. A giant who cries while praying, yet is a force of nature in combat. His Stone Breathing with chains and axe is devastating.
en.O Jackpot 777 é acionado automaticamente: Jackpot 777 is triggered automatically! Hakari expands his Casino Domain infinitely — regenerates +80 HP per turn, +100% damage on all attacks, cooldowns reset, and all enemies suffer -50% defense for 5 turns. The Death Game is eternal.
en.O Jinchuuriki do Juubi e portador do Rin: The Jinchuuriki of the Juubi and wielder of the Rinne Sharingan. Possesses absolute control over all chakra natures, Gudoudama (Truth-Seeking Balls), and the invisible shadows of Limbo. A being who transcended humanity, approaching the power of a god.
en.O Julgador confisca 45% da stamina atual: The Judge confiscates 45% of the opponent’s current stamina, draining their ability to use powerful techniques. Recovers 25% of the confiscated stamina.
en.A herança maldita e o gênio incomparável: The cursed inheritance and the unparalleled genius of Itachi Uchiha. A lethal combination of Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, and the eternal flames of the Mangekyou Sharingan. Each skill used stacks 'Corvo Illusion'. At 100%, the crows protect Itachi, guaranteeing automatic evasion.
en.A katana Nichirin usa a luz solar absorv: The Nichirin katana uses absorbed sunlight to ignite the cut, causing additional damage that prevents demon regeneration.
en.A katana de Maki Zenin após despertar o: Maki Zenin's katana after awakening the Heavenly Body. It cuts everything — physical, spiritual, and cursed — without distinction.
en.A katana de Yorichi Tsugikuni, o mais po: Yorichi Tsugikuni's katana, the most powerful Demon Slayer of all time and creator of the Breath of the Sun. Forged to destroy Muzan Kibutsuji, it is the most feared weapon in history.
en.A katana impregnada com a Energia Maldit: The katana imbued with Rika's unlimited Cursed Energy, used by Special Grade-0 Yuta Okkotsu. One of the most powerful blades ever seen.
en.A katana padrão forjada com aço Nichirin: The standard katana forged from Nichirin steel for Demon Slayers. Simple, reliable, and deadly in the right hands — capable of decapitating any Demon by absorbing sunlight into the blade.
en.A katana pessoal de Toji Fushiguro, o As: Toji Fushiguro's personal katana, the Sorcerer Killer. Forged to kill those who use Cursed Energy, even without having any.
en.A lança penetra qualquer defesa de energ: The spear penetrates any cursed energy defense, nullifying shields and barriers.
en.A lança se divide em milhares de pequena: The spear splits into thousands of small kunai blades that rain down on the enemy.
en.A lança traversa as defesas do inimigo s: The spear pierces the enemy's defenses without them noticing the trajectory.
en.A lendária Espada de Oito Cabos — forjad: The legendary Eight-Handed Sword — forged beyond human limits. Capable of undoing any mystical reinforcement and turning its power against weakened enemies.
en.A lendária armadura vermelha do Fantasma: The legendary red armor of the Uchiha Ghost. Grants great defense and strength, as well as striking fear into opponents in close combat.
en.A lendária técnica de 16 hits. Uma tempe: The legendary 16-hit technique. A storm of relentless, devastating slashes.
The full moon illuminates the battlefield. Prepare to face my Moon Breathing.
en.A luz divina pune com mais intensidade a: Divine light punishes those who still possess strength with greater intensity. Damage scales with the target's CURRENT HP: enemies at full health take up to 2.5× base damage; enemies at the limit take less. The opposite of Sukuna's Cleavage — arrogance has a price.
en.A lâmina Nichirin de coloração amarelo-d: Zenitsu Agatsuma's yellow-golden Nichirin blade. The moment his fear turns into courage, this blade's speed surpasses thunder.
The cursed blade of Upper Moon 1. Master swordsman and user of the legendary Moon Breathing.
en.A lâmina de Giyuu Tomioka, o Hashira da: Giyuu Tomioka's blade, the Water Hashira. Dark blue in color, reflecting the depth of water. Each strike flows with the force of an unstoppable river.
en.A lâmina de Kanao Tsuyuri, discípula da: Kanao Tsuyuri's blade, disciple of the Insect Hashira. Sakura-pink in color with surgical precision. Her eyes catch every movement before it happens.
en.A lâmina de Kyojuro Rengoku, o Hashira d: Kyojuro Rengoku's blade, the Flame Hashira. Forged from orange-reddish Nichirin steel, it burns with the flame of Rengoku's determined heart.
en.A lâmina de Sanemi Shinazugawa, o Hashir: Sanemi Shinazugawa's blade, the Wind Hashira. Light green in color like the wind. It bears the scars of countless battles and the rage of a warrior who never backed down.
en.A lâmina demoníaca de Michikatsu Tsugiku: Michikatsu Tsugikuni's demonic blade, the Upper Moon One Demon. The sword grows directly from his body, merges with his flesh, and Moon Breathing creates slashes that change angle like the moon itself.
en.A lâmina envolve o alvo como uma cobra q: The blade wraps around the target like a constricting snake, causing increasing damage.
en.A lâmina envolve o alvo em arco amplo, c: The blade wraps around the target in a wide arc, causing multiple slashes.
en.A lâmina etérea que sela qualquer coisa: The ethereal blade seals anything it pierces in an eternal genjutsu. If it hits the target, it removes all of their buffs.
en.A lâmina flexível atinge ângulos impossí: The flexible blade strikes at angles impossible for a normal katana.
The flexible blade strikes at impossible angles.
en.A lâmina ondula como escamas, criando co: The blade ripples like scales, creating slashes from multiple angles.
en.A lâmina ondula como escamas, criando mú: The blade ripples like scales, creating multiple angles.
en.A lâmina ondula como uma serpente, crian: The blade ripples like a serpent, creating multiple attack angles.
en.A lâmina sinuosa de Obanai Iguro, o Hash: Obanai Iguro's winding blade, the Serpent Hashira. The blade is crooked like a snake, making his movements completely unpredictable.
en.A lâmina única de Mitsuri Kanroji, a Has: Mitsuri Kanroji's unique blade, the Love Hashira. Eight times thinner than a normal katana and extremely flexible, created especially for her unique muscles.
en.A lâmina única de Shinobu Kocho, a Hashi: Shinobu Kocho's unique blade, the Insect Hashira. Needle-thin with a tip filled with wisteria poison — the deadliest substance to demons.
en.A maldição do Rei das Maldições gravada: The King of Curses' curse engraved on your skin — a power that devours the host. +45 Strength, +30 Defense, +10% Crit, +20% Sword Damage. However, it hinders dodging and healing — you cannot rely on passive defense against the King.
en.A poderosa técnica dos Hashiras de Chama: The powerful technique of the Flame Hashiras. Every strike burns with the intensity of the sun and the determination of a true Hashira.
en.A própria morte manifestada em forma fís: Death itself manifested in physical form to collect souls this Halloween.
en.A próxima habilidade ignora redução de d: The next skill ignores damage reduction, cannot fail, and costs 0 energy. Reusing skills does not reset the passive.
en.A rara lâmina Nichirin de coloração negr: The rare black Nichirin blade of Tanjiro Kamado. The black color is said to bring bad luck, but in Tanjiro's hands it became the symbol of the Breath of the Sun.
en.O Julgador confisca 45% da stamina do op: The Judge seizes 45% of the opponent's stamina, drains 15% of that stamina to the user, and blocks any stamina recovery from the target for 3 turns. The Judge's law is absolute.
en.O Julgador inclina a Balança da Justiça,: The Judge tilts the Scales of Justice, accumulating 1 Judgment Seal (max 5). The basic attack deals 70 damage + 40 additional damage per accumulated Seal. The more seals, the heavier the sentence.
en.O Julgamento Final. Enel condensa nuvens: The Final Judgment. Enel condenses storm clouds into a massive sphere and drops it, annihilating anything within the blast radius. Applies full control if the target survives.
en.O Jutsu Supremo. Projeta o Rinne Sharing: The Supreme Jutsu. Projects the Rinne Sharingan onto the moon. Everyone is subjected to an eternal trance. Deals catastrophic damage and stuns the opponent for a long time.
en.O Lorde dos Demônios. Usa seu próprio co: The Demon Lord. Uses his own body, infinite adaptability, and lightning-fast flesh whips.
en.O Paraíso do Gelo. Douma fundou um culto: The Ice Paradise. Douma founded a religious cult while devouring followers. His ice fans create storms that freeze even the soul.
en.O Rasengan amplificado com chakra natura: The Rasengan amplified with natural chakra from the Sennin. The chakra penetrates the enemy's cellular structure, causing internal damage.
en.O Susano Completo de Sasuke — o titã div: Sasuke's Complete Susano — the divine chakra titan in its final form. Launches the Indra Arrow, the most powerful weapon created by a human being.
en.O Tesouro Sagrado de Ban. Um bastão de q: Ban's Sacred Treasure. A four-section staff that greatly enhances the user's ability to steal strength and speed.
en.O Tesouro Sagrado de Diane. Um martelo g: Diane's Sacred Treasure. A giant hammer that channels the power of the earth.
en.O Tesouro Sagrado de Gowther. Arcos de l: Gowther's Sacred Treasure. Arrows of light capable of invading the enemy's mind.
en.O Tesouro Sagrado de King, o Rei das Fad: King's Sacred Treasure, the Fairy King. Made from the Sacred Tree, it has several forms with unique properties.
en.O Tesouro Sagrado de Meliodas. Lostvayne: Meliodas's Sacred Treasure. Lostvayne allows the wielder to create clones of himself, although his full power is divided.
en.O Tesouro Sagrado de Merlin. Uma esfera: Merlin's Sacred Treasure. A crystal sphere that allows the use of infinite magic.
en.O acorde final de Tengen. Uma detonação: Tengen's final chord. An explosion of light and sound that blinds and crushes the target at the same time.
en.O ataque derradeiro do Jogo da Morte — H: Hakari's ultimate attack of the Death Game — Hakari summons all his power into a single apocalyptic blow that destroys the entire area. Guaranteed damage, automatic critical, and the enemy is paralyzed for 3 turns. The Death Game reaches its absolute end.
en.O ataque supremo de Gilthunder. Concentr: Gilthunder's supreme attack. Concentrates all atmospheric power into a single devastating lightning strike that wipes out the enemy's resistance.
en.O bastão de Hajime Kashimo, o feiticeiro: Hajime Kashimo's staff, the strongest cursed sorcerer of the Heian era. Conducts pure cursed electricity with impossible force.
en.O bastão de ouro maciço de Enel, o 'Deus: Enel's solid gold staff, the 'God' of Skypiea. Besides being an excellent blunt weapon, its golden conductivity allows perfect channeling of electricity, increasing lethality and precision.
en.O bastão libera uma tempestade elétrica: The staff releases an electric storm that covers the entire field. Technique refined with 400 years of combat experience.
en.O bastão se estende para roubar a força: The staff extends to steal the opponent's life force and stamina from a distance.
en.O cajado complementa o estilo de combate: The staff complements Frieren's combat style with support and control. It offers utility and preparation for the next turn, with its passive 'Millennial Catalyst' increasing the effectiveness of the next magic skill.
en.O cajado ressoa com a mana do usuário, r: The staff resonates with the user's mana, restoring 15 energy and reducing a random skill cooldown by 1 turn.
en.O cataclismo de Sanemi. Cria um tufão de: Sanemi's cataclysm. Creates a whirlwind of blades that destroys any defense.
en.O cataclismo de Sanemi. Um tufão de lâmi: Sanemi's cataclysm. A whirlwind of blades that destroys everything.
en.O chakra da Kurama envolve Naruto comple: Kurama's chakra completely envelops Naruto. Restores 80 HP, grants a massive shield, and a fox combat stance.
en.O chakra vermelho da Kurama envolve o co: Kurama's red chakra envelops the body like flames. Restores 50 HP and grants a 40 defense shield for 2 turns.
en.O clone Sekido lança raios que atingem t: Sekido's clone unleashes lightning that strikes all nearby enemies.
en.O clone da alegria emite ondas sonoras s: The joy clone emits super-powered sound waves from its mouth.
en.O clone da raiva dispara relâmpagos perf: The rage clone fires piercing lightning from its khakkhara staff.
en.O clone da tristeza utiliza uma Lança Cr: The sadness clone uses a lethal Cross Spear at absurd speed.
en.O clone do relaxamento usa seu leque de: The relaxation clone uses its leaf fan to unleash cutting winds.
en.O clone mais poderoso que comanda as mad: The most powerful clone that commands wood and destroys everything around it.
en.O corpo de Gyomei atinge a densidade do: Gyomei's body reaches diamond density. The counterattack returns the received damage, amplified, to the enemy.
en.O corpo verdadeiro de Hantengu libera to: Hantengu's true body releases all accumulated rage in a single devastating blow that ignores defense.
en.O corte mais básico do Rei — mas ainda a: The King's most basic slash — but still devastating. A single movement that tears apart everything in its path.
en.O corte que aniquila o espírito. Causa d: The slash that annihilates the spirit. Deals massive damage that scales with the enemy's missing life (Execution).
en.O corte que atravessa TEMPO e ESPAÇO. Re: The slash that crosses TIME and SPACE. Requires having used Sanctuary. Consumes 100 Hegemony. Damage: 650 base, multiplies by (1 + target's Lacerations). Ignores absolutely EVERYTHING, including revivals. If the target survives: remains at 1 HP + CURSED (permanent in battle: -80% def, no healing, max stamina -50%, Sukuna damage doubled). Final execution.
en.O corte que imita o amanhecer, trazendo: The slash that imitates dawn, bringing devastating light to the target.
The slash that imitates dawn, bringing devastating light.
en.A Restrição Celestial de Maki Zenin — el: Maki Zenin’s Heavenly Restriction — she gave up all cursed energy in exchange for a perfect, unbreakable, and lethal human body. Accumulate Brute Force with each strike to amplify her power, negate the opponent’s techniques with the Inverted Heaven Spear, awaken the Void Body to transcend her physical limits, and destroy everything with Dragon Bone and Total Zenin Elimination.
en.A Roda das Oito Manipulações de Mahoraga: Mahoraga’s Eightfold Wheel of Manipulation — the cursed spirit that never yields. Absorbs **162 HP** of damage as a shield and regenerates **+12 HP** per turn through infinite adaptation. However, it sacrifices offensive power for supreme defense.
en.A Roda das Purificações forma uma barrei: The Wheel of Purifications forms a barrier around the user, converting assimilated damage into healing and a temporary shield.
en.A Roda gira em velocidade máxima, espalh: The Wheel spins at maximum speed, spreading scorching cursed energy in an area. It burns those who survive the impact.
en.A Técnica Inata da Anjo — um poder celes: The Angel’s Innate Technique — a celestial power of purified divine light capable of extinguishing any curse. Accumulate Rays of Light to amplify your attacks, forge a Sacred Shield that absorbs, heals, and reflects, purify your curses by converting them into strength, condemn the powerful with light proportional to their arrogance, and expand the domain of Forbidden Paradise — which absorbs all damage received and returns it as a devastating explosion.
en.A Técnica Inata de Hajime Kashimo — o Fe: Hajime Kashimo’s Innate Technique — the Legendary Sorcerer who waited 400 years to fight the ultimate battle. His body channels primordial electricity, accumulate Electric Charges to amplify his power, activate the Thunder Mark to conduct your enemy, enter the Spiritual Beast Electric Form to triple your potential, and destroy everything with the Miraculous Nature Domain — transforming into pure electricity that ravages the battlefield.
en.A Técnica Inata de Hakari Kinji: um jogo: Hakari Kinji’s Innate Technique: a cursed pachinko game that defies death. Accumulate Tokens with each attack and spin the reels. Upon reaching JACKPOT 777, Hakari becomes virtually immortal for 4 turns — cooldowns reset, full stamina, +50 HP per turn, and +50% damage on all attacks. The Expanded Domain guarantees the Jackpot!
en.A Técnica Inata de Hiromi Higuruma que i: Hiromi Higuruma’s Innate Technique that summons the shikigami Judge. Accuses the opponent of a crime and, if found GUILTY, confiscates all of their cursed energy. Death Penalty is devastating against exhausted targets!
en.A Técnica Inata de Shoko Ieiri — domínio: Shoko Ieiri’s Innate Technique — absolute mastery over cursed anatomy. Heal yourself and allies, remove debuffs, erect the Surgical Barrier that absorbs blows converting them into HP, apply Reverse Poison that turns the enemy’s strength into weakness, and open the Operating Field — a Reverse Domain that turns the battlefield into a cursed hospital where each turn regenerates you and heals your allies.
en.A Técnica Inata de Uraume — a fiel serva: Uraume’s Innate Technique — the faithful servant of Ryomen Sukuna. Uraume manipulates cursed energy to freeze and crystallize everything around them. Each hit accumulates Crystallization on the enemy, progressively amplifying ice damage. The Path of Ice turns the battlefield into a kinetic advantage, the Glacial Barrier reflects fragments back at the attacker, Partial Freeze paralyzes the target’s offense and defense, and Glacial Explosion detonates all accumulated crystallizations in a single devastating blast. At maximum form — Domain: Eternal Storm — the entire battlefield becomes a perpetual storm where freezing is inevitable and the final detonation, inevitable.
en.A Técnica Inata de Utahime Iori — a Feit: Utahime Iori’s Innate Technique — the Special Grade Sorcerer responsible for coordinating and teaching the new generation. Her Forbidden Solo Area technique amplifies the cursed energy of all allies around her, raising the entire team’s combat potential beyond normal limits. She fights not only with brute force, but with surgical support: melodic barriers, resonant healing, energy synchronization, and the devastating 100% Forbidden Area that can double an entire team’s power in a single activation.
en.A Técnica Inata de Yuki Tsukumo — a Feit: Yuki Tsukumo’s Innate Technique — the Special Grade Sorcerer who challenged the system itself. By assigning Imaginary Mass to her body, Yuki transcends humanity’s physical limits and distorts the reality around her. Accumulate Imaginary Mass to passively amplify each hit, destroy areas with Mass Pulse, negate attacks with Star Vacuum, suffocate the opponent with the Gravitational Field, convert all accumulated mass into devastating Singularity, awaken the Stellar Form to triple your potential, and collapse everything with Domain: Stellar Collapse.
en.A Venuzdonoa manifesta seu poder absolut: Venuzdonoa manifests its absolute power and delivers a blow that defies the laws of reality, destroying the target’s protections and magical effects.
en.A apatia total de Douma permite que ele: Douma’s total apathy allows him to ignore debuffs and restore 30% of his own stamina, reflecting 20% of the physical damage received on the next turn.
en.A areia envolve o alvo, causando dano mé: The sand envelops the target, dealing moderate damage and potentially stunning them through compression.
en.A areia protege o usuário com um escudo: The sand protects the user with its own shield and automatic interception against the next damage received.

en.Dispara uma rápida centelha elétrica con: Fires a rapid electric spark at the target, building static charge.
en.Dispersa células demoníacas em toda a ár: Disperses demonic cells throughout the area, striking multiple points on the opponent's body.

en.Invoca uma Mersa — criatura marinha mald: Summons a Mersa — a cursed sea creature created by Dagon — that chases and attacks the enemy for 4 turns, dealing water damage and applying WET. Maximum of 2 Mersas on the field at once. Mersas scale with Tide Synchronization.
en.Invoca uma besta de eletricidade que ava: Summons an electricity beast that charges through the area, overloading enemies with electric stress.

en.Ao usar !energiamaldita com esta técnica: When using !energiamaldita with this technique equipped, the user can initiate the 7-Day Contract with Jashin. Each day requires 100,000 total damage in battles; completing it grants +10% damage to Hidan, failing removes 10%. If at 0%, failures become a negative penalty. At the end of 7 days, the contract resets and can be started again.
en.Ao usar 'Julgamento', o oponente fica so: When using 'Judgment', the opponent is put on trial on their next turn. Verdict: 60% GUILTY (loses all stamina) or 40% INNOCENT. 'Death Penalty' scales with the target's missing stamina — more lethal the more exhausted they are.

en.Shoko distribui sua energia vital entre: Shoko distributes her life force among allies. Heals 25% of own HP and reduces her own cooldowns by 2 turns. In raids: heals all allies for 45% of max HP and reduces each one's cooldowns by 2 turns. Amplified by Healing Charges. Accumulates 2 Healing Charges.
en.Uraume solidifica a energia maldita ao s: Uraume solidifies the cursed energy around it into a thick ice shield. The barrier absorbs up to **100 HP** of damage. Upon absorbing any hit, **25% of the absorbed damage is reflected back** at the attacker as ice shards. If the barrier is destroyed, the ice break **automatically applies 1 stack of Crystallization** to the enemy. Uraume’s ice wounds even as it breaks.
en.Usa flexibilidade extrema para atacar de: Uses extreme flexibility to attack from impossible angles.
en.Usa o Gunbai para absorver o impacto de: Uses the Gunbai to absorb the impact of enemy attacks and reflect them as a wind explosion. Stuns the enemy that attacks and defends.
Uses the power of the Rinne Sharingan on the forehead. The target is trapped in a powerful illusion, becoming severely stunned and having their attack stats reduced (Tsukuyomi Debuff/Illusion).
en.Usa sua técnica exclusiva desenvolvida a: Uses their exclusive technique developed over centuries of existence.
en.Usa suas presas recém-adquiridas para de: Uses its newly acquired fangs to tear flesh apart and absorb energy.
en.Usa uma lâmina de sombra imbuída com ene: Uses a shadow blade imbued with forbidden cursed energy.
en.Usa uma técnica de supressão que drena a: Uses a suppression technique that drains the opponent's cursed energy and strengthens its own defense.
en.Utahime Iori ativa sua técnica limitante: Utahime Iori activates her limiting technique at maximum capacity. The cursed energy gravitational field expands across the entire battle: it deals devastating damage to the enemy and for **2 turns** all allies receive +**150%** damage, **guaranteed crits** on all attacks, and **+65 HP regeneration per turn**. The Forbidden Area at 150% is not just a technique — it is the statement that Utahime was never just an instructor.
en.Utahime afina sua voz com energia maldit: Utahime tunes her voice with cursed energy and lands a resonant strike. At the same time, she amplifies the energy of one random ally — or herself in solo combat — granting +35% damage for 3 turns. Every melody sung on the battlefield is an investment in the collective offense.
en.Utahime ativa metade de sua técnica limi: Utahime activates half of her limiting technique — the Forbidden Area at 80%. Deals moderate damage to the target and establishes an amplification field that raises **+80% damage for all allies** and provides **+50 HP per turn** for **3 turns**. In solo combat, all benefits are applied to herself. Even at half capacity, the impact is substantial.
en.Utahime canta uma melodia de proteção qu: Utahime sings a protective melody that solidifies cursed energy around all her allies. Each ally receives a barrier of **120 HP** that absorbs the next set of damage. In solo combat, the barrier protects herself. No ally falls while Utahime's melody echoes.
en.Utahime inverte brevemente a energia mal: Utahime briefly reverses cursed energy into improvised reverse technique, channeling waves of healing across the battlefield. Recovers **35% of maximum HP** in solo combat, or **35% of self + 22% of each ally's maximum HP** in Raids. Utahime's talent lies in making others shine.
en.Utahime sincroniza a frequência de energ: Utahime synchronizes the cursed energy frequency of the whole team with her own. For **3 turns**: all allies (and herself) receive **debuff immunity** and regenerate **+70 Stamina per turn**. In solo combat, the effects apply only to herself. Utahime's synchronization is what keeps the team functional even under extreme pressure.
en.Utahime sobe o nível de sua técnica e em: Utahime raises the level of her technique and emits an amplification wave that pierces all allies simultaneously. For **2 turns**, everyone receives +**60%** damage. In solo combat, the amplification applies entirely to herself. This is the essence of the Forbidden Area: not the power of one person, but of everyone.
en.VINGANÇA (0-100%): Acumula conforme você: REVENGE (0-100%): Builds up as you take damage. At 100%, releases REVENGE COUNTER with tripled damage. FULL COUNTER: The next attack received is reflected with 2x the original damage. ASSAULT MODE: +60% damage, -40% damage received, and Black Flames on every hit.
en.Versão amplificada do Rasengan com chakr: Amplified version of Rasengan with concentrated chakra from the entire length of the arm. Impact destroys the surroundings.
en.Versão desperta da Técnica Máxima. Críti: Awakened version of the Maximum Technique. Guaranteed crit on all. +2 Counters. Each Balance +20 damage.
en.Versão desperta do Ponto Fraco. Crit gar: Awakened version of Weak Point. Crit guaranteed x1.7. If counter = 7: x3.0 + Fragmented 3 turns + +2 Balances.
en.Versão despertada da Pena de Morte: o da: Awakened version of the Death Penalty: damage scales 2x with the target's missing HP. If the target is below 25% HP, the sentence is executed instantly — guaranteed death by the Tribunal.
en.Versão mítica evoluída da técnica de Mah: Evolved mythic version of Mahito's technique. Manipulates soul, flesh, and spiritual echo with tactical variations for PvP, combat, Raids, and Global Boss.
en.Versão perfeita do corte. Requer 80+ Heg: Perfect version of the slash. Requires 80+ Hegemony (consumes only 20). Damage: 400 + (missing HP × 0.8). Ignores EVERYTHING. Applies King's Mark + Spatial Separation. Can be used within the Sanctuary.
en.Você foi indicado como ameaça ao Clã. A: You have been designated as a threat to the Clan. The elimination begins now.

In raids: while the poison is active, all allies also receive 10 HP of healing per turn.
en.Shoko usa seu conhecimento anatômico par: Shoko uses her anatomical knowledge to strike the opponent's neural points. Deals damage and applies Weakening: the target deals -30% damage for 2 turns. In raids: all allies receive 150 HP of healing while Shoko strikes.
en.Sistema de 8 habilidades retrabalhadas c: 8-skill system reworked with chained mechanics of Copy Echoes, Bond Marks, and Manifestation Pact. Rika can be summoned with a sacrifice of 45% of the user's maximum life to act in combat for turns.

en.Skills que não stunam ganham 15% de chan: Skills that do not stun gain a 15% chance to stun.

en.Soca o ar com tanta força que cria ondas: Punches the air with such force that it creates directional shockwaves.
en.Soco revestido com Ki negro e rosé que i: Punch coated with black and rosé Ki that impacts the target's energy structure.

en.Sua alma alimentará meus subordinados!: Your soul will feed my subordinates!
en.Sua energia amaldiçoada pertence a mim!: Your cursed energy belongs to me!
en.Sua energia maldita é minha agora!: Your cursed energy is mine now!

The one-handed axe used by Escanor. So heavy that even Meliodas couldn't carry it, Rhitta stores the sun's heat to be released in battle.
en.O machado espalha golpes em arco que esm: The axe spreads arcing blows that crush multiple targets.
en.O mangual encadeado com machado de ponta: Gyomei Himejima's chained flail with axe tip, the Stone Pillar and the strongest of the Hashira. Forged with special Nichirin metal, it smashes the bones of Upper Moon Demons.
en.O martelo e os pregos de Kugisaki Nobara: Kugisaki Nobara's hammer and nails, used in the Cursed Technique: Straw Doll. They transmit damage through objects linked to the target.
en.O monstro imortal sob o controle da famí: The immortal monster under the control of the Hellsing family. Uses his weapons, familiars, and his own blood to massacre his enemies. A monster that cannot die, and whose souls feed his thirst for blood.

en.O poder do Rinnegan — Sasuke libera uma: The power of the Rinnegan — Sasuke unleashes an absolute gravitational repulsion that hurls everything around with devastating force.
en.O poder proibido de Orochimaru, o Sannin: The forbidden power of Orochimaru, the Rogue Sannin. His techniques infuse mortal poison and summon colossal serpents, stacking Cursed Mark that culminates in the transformation into Great White Serpent.
en.O progenitor de todos os Demônios. Trans: The progenitor of all Demons. He transformed for over 1000 years seeking to surpass sunlight. His mere presence crushes the will of the strongest.
en.O relâmpago concentrado na palma — o gol: Lightning concentrated in the palm — the thousand birds strike. Pierces any physical defense and stacks 1 Mangekyou Charge.

en.Julgamento despertado: o Julgador procla: Awakened Judgment: the Judge pronounces the sentence with a 65% chance of GUILTY. If convicted, the crime is permanent — the opponent is marked and loses double stamina. Stacks 1 Judgment Seal.
Kaburamaru... did you see? That warrior... is worthy.

Kanao mimics the erratic movement of petals to confuse.

en.Kashimo dispara um raio primordial que s: Kashimo fires a primordial bolt that jumps between all enemies. Each jump deals 100% of the original damage. In addition, it stacks 1 Electric Charge per enemy hit. Electricity always finds the fastest path.
en.Kashimo expande o Domínio da Natureza Mi: Kashimo expands the Domain of Miraculous Nature — transforming into pure electricity. en.Kashimo imprime uma marca elétrica no in: Kashimo imprints an electric mark on the enemy, making them a perfect conductor of electricity. For 3 turns, each of your attacks automatically deals +45 additional electric damage. Electricity finds its path.
en.Kashimo invoca a forma máxima do espírit: Kashimo summons the maximum form of the electric spirit — the God of Lightning. en.Kashimo libera TODAS as Cargas Elétricas: Kashimo releases ALL accumulated Electric Charges in a simultaneous explosion. Each charge adds +36 extra damage. With 5 charges: maximum devastation. The bet on patience — the more you stack, the more destructive the result.
en.Kashimo libera TODAS as cargas elétricas: Kashimo releases ALL electric charges in a devastating supernova. Each charge deals +40 extra damage. After the explosion, 1 Charge is automatically recharged. Electricity never ceases.
en.Kashimo se move em velocidade de raio —: Kashimo moves at lightning speed — dodges the next attack AND automatically retaliates with an electric counterattack dealing 130 damage. Speed and electricity fuse into pure instinct.
Kashimo moves at lightning speed — strikes the enemy and simultaneously positions himself to dodge the next attack. The next hit received will be automatically dodged.
en.A arma definitiva de Toji Fushiguro — a: Toji Fushiguro's ultimate weapon — the Inverted Spear of Heaven that nullifies any cursed technique. Forged with fragments from the Cursed Inventory.
en.A arma padrão dos shinobis da Aldeia da: The standard weapon of the shinobi of the Hidden Leaf Village. Simple, fast, and deadly in the hands of an experienced ninja.

en.A bola de chakra comprimida criada pelo: The compressed chakra ball created by the Yondaime and perfected by Naruto. Concentrated impact on the vital point.

en.A forma base da lança, desferindo uma pe: The spear's base form, delivering a powerful piercing strike.

en.A fusão suprema do Infinito. Um projétil: The supreme fusion of Infinity. An imaginary mass projectile that erases everything in its path, ignoring 100% of defense and dealing colossal damage.
en.Tengen bate as duas lâminas encadeadas c: Tengen strikes both chained blades creating a sound shockwave that bursts eardrums and causes stun.
en.Tengen detona as cargas de suas lâminas: Tengen detonates the charges in his blades at two points simultaneously.
Tengen detonates the charges in his blades at two points.
en.Tengen detona todas as cargas explosivas: Tengen detonates all accumulated explosive charges at once in a single devastating explosion. Ultimate technique of the Sound Pillar.
en.Tengen usa técnicas ninja para se teletr: Tengen uses ninja techniques to teleport and eliminate minor threats, healing 15% of HP.
en.Todos os seus ataques causam dano em áre: All your attacks deal area damage.
en.Todos que olham para Enmu caem num pesad: Anyone who looks at Enmu falls into a terrible nightmare. Inevitably stuns and applies 3 Sleep Marks.
en.Toji Fushiguro — o Assassino de Feiticei: Toji Fushiguro — the Sorcerer Killer. His Heavenly Restriction erased all cursed energy in exchange for superhuman physical attributes. Master the Cursed Inventory: 4 legendary weapons with unique effects. Chain them in devastating combos to maximize power. Build Predator Instinct with every hit. Activate Survival Instinct when near death. Enter Spectral Hunter Mode and exterminate with the Sorcerer Killer.
en.Toji canalizou toda sua força física alé: Toji channeled all his physical strength beyond human limits. The strike pierces through any Cursed Energy defense as if it did not exist.
en.Tornozeleiras leves que aumentam mobilid: Light anklets that increase mobility and evasion. Essential for those who prefer speed.
en.Transfere todo dano de água de um alvo M: Transfers all water damage from a WET target to all adjacent enemies. Heals you for 30% of the transferred damage. Resets WET stacks.
en.Transforma o campo em deserto dourado, f: Transforms the field into a golden desert, strengthening defenses and draining enemy stamina.
en.Transforma-se em um colossal deus do tro: Transforms into a colossal thunder god made of pure electricity (200.000.000 Volts). Greatly increases attack and defense power. Instantly maximizes 'Divine Voltage' to 300V and restores 20% HP.
en.Transformação monstruosa. Concede poder: Monstrous transformation. Grants Vasto Lorde power (+80% damage, +50 HP/turn).
en.Transformação suprema. Requer 3 almas e: Supreme transformation. Requires 3 souls and HP <= 50%. Increases damage, reduces damage taken, and applies Execution marks to enemies below 15% HP.
en.Traz um pouco de sorte para encontrar it: Brings a bit of luck to find rare items.

en.Trovão Dark — Sétima Forma Proibida: Fen: Dark Thunder — Seventh Forbidden Form: Heir's Rift
en.Trovão Dark — Terceira Forma: Enxame de: Dark Thunder — Third Form: Thunder Mosquito Swarm
en.Técnica aprendida ao lutar contra Mahora: Technique learned while fighting Mahoraga. Inverts the enemy's Cursed Energy flow, causing internal damage.
en.Técnica básica que acumula e manipula en: Basic technique that accumulates and manipulates cursed energy. Each energy burst packs more power!
en.Técnica de Hidan focada em coletar sangu: Hidan's technique focused on collecting blood, forming the Jashin Seal, and returning damage through the Ritual Bond. Strong when the user plans positioning, contract, and self-sacrifice.
en.Técnica de Sangue do Lua Inferior 1. Con: Lower Moon 1 Blood Technique. Controls dreams and nightmares, plunging enemies into deadly unconsciousness.
en.Técnica de Suguru Geto reworkada: captur: Reworked Suguru Geto technique: captures techniques like spirits, accumulates its own Cursed Energy, summons persistent curses, and compresses everything into Maximum Uzumaki 200%.
en.Técnica de espírito amaldiçoado que cont: Cursed spirit technique that controls volcanic flames. The heat intensifies with every attack!
en.Técnica de múltiplos modos (Base → Senni: Multi-mode technique (Base → Sennin → Kurama). Every 5 turns gains +1 Chakra Tail (max 9). With 4 tails: +25% damage and +40 HP/turn. With 9 tails: +60% damage, +80 HP/turn and -30% damage received — Bijuu state.
en.As foices gêmeas de Gyutaro, Demônio da: The twin scythes of Gyutaro, Upper Rank Six Demon Moon. Forged from his own solidified demon blood, they carry deadly poison that accumulates in the victim's body with each slash. All skills steal 15% of the damage dealt as life.
en.As garras de chakra da Kurama rasgam o i: Kurama's chakra claws tear the enemy apart with supernatural speed.
en.As habilidades acumulam Reiatsu (0-100%): Abilities accumulate Reiatsu (0-100%). By using abilities from different races, you activate specific effects. Upon reaching 100%, you unlock transcendent abilities.
en.As luvas de combate de Maki Zenin — forj: Maki Zenin's combat gloves — forged to maximize every physical strike. +15% sword damage, +8% critical chance, +20% critical damage. Heavenly Restriction Event reward.
en.As lâminas gêmeas encadeadas com explosi: Tengen Uzui's chained twin blades with explosives, the Sound Pillar. Each blade is covered with explosive charges that detonate on impact, amplifying the destructive power of every strike.
en.As marcas de bestas do clã Inuzuka, pint: The Inuzuka clan's beast marks, painted on Kiba's face. Increases brute strength and combo frequency, mirroring the fighter's wild instinct.
en.Ataca com uma mandíbula de energia maldi: Attacks with a cursed energy jaw that drains life from the enemy.
en.Ataque de alta velocidade no primeiro qu: High-speed attack on the first frame of the sequence.
en.Ataque de velocidade transcendental que: Transcendent speed attack that unleashes 13 simultaneous hits, each striking a different vital point. Created to destroy Muzan.
en.Ataque direto com gravata imbuída de ene: Direct attack with a tie imbued with energy. +1 Counter. If counter = 3 or 7, recovers 8 stamina. Spam viable.
en.Ataque extremamente rápido que confunde: Extremely fast attack that confuses the opponent, ensuring tactical advantage.
en.Ataque rápido aplicado com técnica de ap: Fast attack applied with a stealth approach technique. Hard to defend against.
en.Ataque sincronizado entre Yuta e Rika qu: Synchronized attack between Yuta and Rika that explodes binding marks in an area.
en.Ataque veloz que pode selar a alma do ad: Fast attack that can seal the opponent's soul.
en.Ataques acumulam Energia Infinita (0-200: Attacks accumulate Infinite Energy (0-200). Every 50, gain +15% damage. At 200, activates FULL PURPLE: double damage and automatic stun.
en.Ataques geram Pressão Sanguínea (0-120): Attacks generate Blood Pressure (0-120) and apply Hemorrhage (0-6). Pressure increases damage in tiers; Hemorrhage causes continuous bleeding and strengthens piercing/true damage. Upon reaching 120, activates Hematic Rupture: consumes Hemorrhage for massive damage, stun, life steal, and partial rotation reset. Support skills create Clots for defense, healing, and accelerating the next execution.
en.Atinge diretamente o núcleo espiritual d: Directly hits the target's spiritual core. Deals +100% damage if the target is asleep, ignoring 50% of defense.
en.Ativa a Técnica Amaldiçoada: Boneco de P: Activates the Cursed Technique: Straw Doll, applying continuous cursed poison for 3 turns.
en.Ativa os Seis Olhos em pleno potencial:: Activates the Six Eyes at full potential: Gojo sees all cursed energy with absolute precision. PASSIVE: upon receiving a critical hit or fatal damage, Infinity reacts automatically blocking 60% of that damage (3 charges per activation).
en.Ativa toda a ressonância acumulada na ef: Activates all the resonance accumulated in the effigy: deals bonus damage proportional to the accumulated resonance.
en.Ativado apenas por agentes veteranos — u: Activated only by veteran agents — a slash that partially bypasses cursed energy defenses.
en.Atravesse a névoa em 4 rodadas de caçado: Cross the mist in 4 rounds of hunters and demons before facing Muichiro Tokito, the Mist Pillar. 15% stronger than the old Nanatsu Raid.
Runs over enemies with his horse.
en.Aumenta a chance de encontrar moedas rar: Increases the chance of finding rare coins in missions.
en.Aumenta dano em 50% ao ativar técnica pr: Increases damage by 50% when activating forbidden technique below 40% life
en.Avança rapidamente e desfere um golpe rá: Rushes forward quickly and lands a fast strike.
en.Avanço aéreo veloz que corta o inimigo e: Fast aerial advance that cuts the enemy and increases evasion.
en.Ayato avança em alta velocidade, atraves: Ayato rushes forward at high speed, passes through the target, and slashes with the kagune. The next attack received has a high chance to miss.
en.Ayato prende o inimigo com as asas do ka: Ayato traps the enemy with the kagune wings and tears them apart. Stuns for 1 turn.
en.Balança a Lâmina de Ki com tanta intensi: Swings the Ki Blade with such intensity that it splits space-time into multiple shreds of energy.
en.Balança o machado com força amaldiçoada: Swings the axe with cursed force and unleashes a wave of cutting energy.
en.Ban aumenta sua própria força física ao: Ban increases his own physical strength by stealing vitality from the surroundings. +25% damage and +5% life steal for 3 turns.
en.Ban desfere uma sequência frenética de c: Ban unleashes a frenzied sequence of rapid slashes that hits everyone in the area.
en.Ban estende a mão e arrebata a energia d: Ban extends his hand and snatches the opponent's energy, dealing damage and draining 10% of their maximum stamina.
en.Bankai/Hollow: Uma versão mais densa e p: Bankai/Hollow: A denser and more powerful version of Getsuga Tenshō.
en.Barreira de luz negra que explode em áre: Black light barrier that explodes in an area, reducing enemies' defense.
en.Barreira mágica instantânea. Se possuir: Instant magic barrier. If you have 2+ stacks of the passive: shield increases by +15% of maximum life.
en.Você não é melhor que eu. Só teve mais s: You’re not better than me. You just had more luck!
en.Você tem o olhar de um verdadeiro guerre: You have the gaze of a true warrior. But weakness has no place here!
en.Você veio me deter? Igual ao que fizeram: You came to stop me? Just like they did to my master. It won’t work this time.
en.Você é incrível! Fiquei apaixonada pela: You’re incredible! I fell in love with your strength!
en.Você é incrível... Aprendi muito com ess: You’re incredible... I learned a lot from this battle. Thank you!
en.Você... conseguiu acertar. Impressionant: You... managed to hit me. Impressive.
en.Vocês estão presos em meu genjutsu. Você: You’re trapped in my genjutsu. You have no way to win.
en.Vocês ousam se erguer contra um Deus? O: You dare rise against a God? My judgment will fall upon you!
en.Yorichi executa a primeira forma da Resp: Yorichi performs the first form of the Sun Breathing. The strike ignites with solar energy that pierces any demonic barrier.
en.Yorichi executa as 12 formas da Respiraç: Yorichi performs all 12 forms of the Sun Breathing in uninterrupted sequence — the technique Muzan spent centuries trying to avoid.
en.Yuji libera Energia Maldita em dois pont: Yuji releases Cursed Energy at two opposite points simultaneously, causing a devastating internal explosion.
en.Yuki ativa a forma máxima da sua Técnica: Yuki activates the maximum form of her Innate Technique — assigning Imaginary Mass to her entire body. For 4 turns: all attacks deal +70% damage, crits are guaranteed on every hit, you regenerate 30 HP per turn, and Imaginary Mass buildup is doubled. Yuki’s body becomes a living gravitational phenomenon.
en.Yuki comprime o espaço ao redor de si cr: Yuki compresses the space around herself, creating an absolute gravitational vacuum. The next attack received is completely absorbed — the absorbed damage is reflected back at the attacker at 60%. The mass that absorbs everything gives back what it deserves.
en.Yuki comprime toda a Massa Imaginária ac: Yuki compresses all accumulated Imaginary Mass into a single point and detonates it in absolute singularity. Consumes ALL stacks of Mass: each stack adds +55 bonus damage. With 6 stacks: +330 additional damage. The hit is guaranteed — gravity does not allow evasion.
en.Yuki estabelece um campo de gravidade ma: Yuki establishes a massive gravity field around the opponent. For 3 turns: the enemy suffers 30 crushing damage per turn, Yuki automatically gains 1 Imaginary Mass per turn, and gains +25% passive defense. Existence under extreme gravitational force is not something just any being can withstand.
en.Yuki expande o Domínio do Colapso Estela: Yuki expands the Star Collapse Domain — a universe in gravitational collapse where all matter is consumed. For 4 turns: 80 gravitational damage per turn to the enemy, +100% damage on all attacks, guaranteed crits, and immunity to all debuffs. On expiration: final singularity that deals 40 × accumulated Imaginary Mass as gravitational explosion damage.
en.Yuki imprime Massa Imaginária em seu pun: Yuki imprints Imaginary Mass into her fist and unleashes a blow that distorts local gravity. Each hit accumulates 1 Imaginary Mass (max 6) — each stack grants +12% passive damage on all her attacks. The more mass accumulated, the more devastating each subsequent hit becomes.
en.Yuki libera uma onda de pressão gravitac: Yuki releases a wave of gravitational pressure that crushes the entire area. Damage is amplified by +22 for each active stack of Imaginary Mass — without consuming them. Gains 1 more Imaginary Mass. The more you’ve accumulated, the more brutal and overwhelming the wave becomes.
en.Yuta invoca Rika Orimoto para amplificar: Yuta summons Rika Orimoto to amplify every hit. For 2 turns, every katana attack receives a massive Cursed Energy bonus.
en.Yuta sela uma promessa com Energia Maldi: Yuta seals a promise with Cursed Energy. Deals enormous damage but absorbs part of the backlash onto himself — a high-risk, high-reward strike.
en.Zenitsu acelera seus sentidos ao máximo: Zenitsu pushes his senses to the limit to detect the enemy’s weak point.
en.Zenitsu libera toda a velocidade e potên: Zenitsu unleashes the full speed and power of thunder in a single strike that tears through the air.
en.Zenitsu supera seu medo e entra em modo: Zenitsu overcomes his fear and enters maximum concentration mode — perfect dodge of the next attack.
en.Zenitsu só consegue usar uma técnica de: Zenitsu can only use one breathing technique, but he has mastered it beyond human limits. When fear turns to courage, he becomes the fastest being on the field.
en.Zohakuten invoca serpentes de madeira qu: Zohakuten summons wooden serpents that destroy everything around them.
en.[APENAS EM RAID] O General forja um Vínc: [RAID ONLY] The General forges a permanent Divine Bond with the ally with the lowest HP. Absorbs 80% of all damage the ally would receive from NPCs. While active, his passive grants the guardian -80% NPC damage. Only broken by the guardian’s death — irreversible.
en.É FLAMBOYANT! Prepare-se para um combate: IT'S FLAMBOYANT! Get ready for a breathtaking battle — ninja style!
en.☀️ SOL IMPLACÁVEL: Seus ataques têm 50%: ☀️ RELENTLESS SUN: Your attacks have 50% Armor Penetration against all. Hit enemies suffer [Solar Burn], which prevents any enemy healing for 2 turns and deals continuous true damage, incinerating cells.
en.☠️ VENENO WISTERIA: Cada golpe aplica 1: ☠️ WISTERIA POISON: Each hit applies 1 poison stack. At 3 stacks, the target enters severe poison (20% of HP per turn for 3 turns) and the stacks reset.

es.A arma definitiva de Toji Fushiguro — a: El arma definitiva de Toji Fushiguro — la Lanza Invertida del Cielo que anula cualquier técnica maldita. Forjada con fragmentos del Inventario Maldito.
es.A arma padrão dos shinobis da Aldeia da: El arma estándar de los shinobi de la Aldea de la Hoja. Simple, rápida y mortal en manos de un ninja experimentado.
es.A armadura espectral do Susano de Sasuke: La armadura espectral del Susano de Sasuke Uchiha, manifestada en forma sólida. Uno de los equipos más poderosos del evento Festival Shinobi. Fuerza y defensa absolutas.
es.A arte suprema de Muzan Kibutsuji. Trans: El arte supremo de Muzan Kibutsuji. Transforma y disuelve la materia viva con sangre demoníaca milenaria.
es.A bandana com o símbolo de Konoha riscad: La bandana con el símbolo de Konoha tachado — usada por renegados como Pain e Itachi. Aumenta crítico y daño, pues no tener nada que perder te vuelve más peligroso.
es.A bandana metálica com o símbolo de Kono: La bandana metálica con el símbolo de Konoha. Todo ninja de la Hoja la usa con orgullo. Ligera y resistente, aumenta combo y XP.
es.A bola de chakra comprimida criada pelo: La bola de chakra comprimida creada por Yondaime y perfeccionada por Naruto. Impacto concentrado en el punto vital.
es.A cabaça de areia do Gara do Deserto, pr: La calabaza de arena de Gara del Desierto, llena de arena de defensa automática. Alta defensa y esquiva pasiva contra ataques inesperados.
es.A cada 2 turnos recupera 40% do HP do úl: Cada 2 turnos recupera 40% del HP del último daño recibido.
es.A cada 2 turnos reflete 20% do dano toma: Cada 2 turnos refleja 20% del daño recibido.
es.A cada 3 turnos o stun é garantido no se: Cada 3 turnos el stun está garantizado en tu ataque.
es.A cada 3 turnos, skills de espadas ignor: Cada 3 turnos, skills de espadas ignoran la defensa.
es.A cada 5 turnos recupera 30% de stamina: Cada 5 turnos recupera 30% de stamina (aliados en Raid recuperan 15%).
es.A cada stun sofrido, seu dano de espada: Cada vez que sufre stun, tu daño de espada aumenta en 10%. Si el enemigo esquiva, tu daño aumenta en 20%.
es.A cada turno limpa 1 debuff de si própri: Cada turno limpia 1 debuff de sí mismo (y aliados en Raid).
es.A cada turno passado, ganha 2% de bônus: Cada turno pasado, gana 2% de bonus de daño continuo (máx 10%).
es.A cada turno passado, ganha 3% de bônus: Cada turno pasado, gana 3% de bonus de daño continuo (máx 15%).
La capa icónica de los hechiceros supremos. Ofrece protección incomparable y esquiva excepcional.
es.A chama seletiva de Nezuko detona todo o: La llama selectiva de Nezuko detona todo el campo sin herir a aliados humanos.
es.A coroa de um feiticeiro que domina o pr: La corona de un hechicero que domina su propio dominio expandido. Poder y defensa supremos.
es.A corrente do Inventário Maldito se este: La cadena del Inventario Maldito se extiende y atrapa al objetivo en una explosión de fuerza física pura. Aturde por 1 turno.
es.A criogenia letal do Lua Superior 2. Um: La criogenia letal de la Luna Superior 2. Un sociópata sonriente que congela a sus enemigos hasta los pulmones.
es.A dança do fogo solar com a lâmina negra: La danza del fuego solar con la hoja negra — poder inigualable.
es.A desertora que busca curar. Especialist: La desertora que busca curar. Especialista médica incomparable y soporte indispensable en las batallas más grandes.
es.A detonação final de luz e som — cega e: La detonación final de luz y sonido — ciega y aplasta simultáneamente.
es.A efígie sangra continuamente, transmiti: La efigie sangra continuamente, transmitiendo daño maldito persistente a lo largo de los turnos.
es.A encarnação do poder! Disponível apenas: ¡La encarnación del poder! Disponible solo cerca del mediodía o con calor máximo. Vuelve invencible al usuario y duplica el daño.
La espada absorbe la energía del ambiente. Causa daño masivo en el área y cura al usuario con la fuerza del mundo.
es.A espada desencadeia um ataque frenetica: La espada desata un ataque frenéticamente veloz con los ocho mangos simultáneamente, penetrando cualquier escudo, barrera o armadura sin reducción.
es.A espada destrói a lógica por trás da ha: La espada destruye la lógica detrás de la habilidad enemiga, anulando defensas mágicas, barreras y efectos de protección.
es.A espada do executor invoca o Domínio Ex: La espada del ejecutor invoca el Dominio Expandido de Higuruma. El acusado es juzgado y sentenciado — al fallar la defensa, recibe daño masivo y pierde todas las técnicas por 2 turnos.
es.A espada do executor materializada pelo: La espada del ejecutor materializada por el Dominio de Hiromi Higuruma. Solo existe dentro del juicio — quien es sentenciado a muerte la encuentra.
es.A espada executa o veredicto de confisco: La espada ejecuta el veredicto de confiscación, drenando 45% de la stamina actual del enemigo. Higuruma recupera 40% de la stamina drenada.
es.A espada reta de Sasuke Uchiha, forjada: La espada recta de Sasuke Uchiha, forjada con el chakra del Sharingan. Una de las armas más temidas en la Era de los Shinobi.
es.A famosa skill de 16 hits usada pelo Esp: La famosa skill de 16 hits usada por el Espadachín Negro, desgarrando al oponente.
es.A ferramenta especial de grau especial q: La herramienta especial de grado especial que niega y anula cualquier técnica maldita. El golpe cancela todos los buffs y mecánicas activas del oponente por 1 turno — ningún poder maldito resiste a ella. Acumula 1 Fuerza Bruta.
es.A ferramenta reforçada e enfaixada de Ke: La herramienta reforzada y vendada de Kento Nanami, el Hechicero Asalariado de Grado 1. La Técnica Proporción 7:3 es letal en cualquier estructura.
es.A ferramenta suprema do Inventário Maldi: La herramienta suprema del Inventario Maldito — el arma definitiva de Toji Fushiguro, recompensa del Evento Restricción Celestial. Desgarra cualquier protección de energía maldita con fuerza bruta absoluta.
es.A forma Amaru alcança o limite divino, c: La forma Amaru alcanza el límite divino, condensando toda la voltaje mundial en un único cataclismo de proporciones absurdas.
es.A forma base da lança, desferindo uma pe: La forma base de la lanza, asestando una perforación poderosa.
es.A forma exclusiva de Tokito: alterna len: La forma exclusiva de Tokito: alterna lentitud y aceleración absurda. Consume Capas y Rastros para daño escalable; con el Laberinto completo, activa Desaparición Absoluta, perforación profunda y defensa nebulosa superior.
es.A forma suprema do Julgamento. Por 5 tur: La forma suprema del Juicio. Por 5 turnos: +80% de daño, +80 HP/turno, inmunidad a stun y todo ataque instaura Juicio automático. Al expirar, todos los Sellos acumulados explotan — 90 de daño por Sello en una detonación final devastadora.
es.A fusão suprema do Infinito. Um projétil: La fusión suprema del Infinito. Un proyectil de masa imaginaria que borra todo a su paso, ignorando 100% de la defensa y causando daño colosal.
es.*chora*... Você tem a força de uma monta: *llora*... Tienes la fuerza de una montaña. Que Dios te bendiga.
es....*rezando em silêncio*... Que Deus pro: ...*rezando en silencio*... Que Dios proteja tu alma después de esta batalla.
es....Que chama extraordinária você tem. Me: ...Qué llama extraordinaria tienes. ¡Mi corazón arde de satisfacción!
es....Tcha. Você é forte. Mas não pense que: ...Tsk. Eres fuerte. Pero no creas que lo admití fácilmente.
es....Você é forte. Espero que use essa for: ...Eres fuerte. Espero que uses esa fuerza para combatir a Muzan.
es....o Clã saberá desta derrota. Isso não: ...el Clan sabrá de esta derrota. Esto no termina aquí.

es.15% de chance de ignorar completamente u: 15% de chance de ignorar completamente un ataque especial enemigo.

es.20% de chance de perturbar o foco reduzi: 20% de chance de perturbar el enfoque reduciendo crítico
es.20% de chance de usar uma ferramenta esc: 20% de chance de usar una herramienta oculta para contraatacar
es.25% de chance de bloquear regeneração de: 25% de chance de bloquear regeneración de vida
es.25% de chance de contra-atacar com explo: 25% de chance de contraatacar con explosión de energía maldita
es.25% de chance de drenar stamina com gás: 25% de chance de drenar stamina con gas maldito
es.25% de chance de interferir nas técnicas: 25% de chance de interferir en las técnicas aumentando cooldowns
es.25% de chance de quebrar sequências de c: 25% de chance de romper secuencias de combos
es.30% de chance de bloquear regeneração de: 30% de chance de bloquear regeneración de vida al absorber energía vital
es.30% de chance de corroer a defesa com mi: 30% de chance de corroer la defensa con miasma de maldición
es.30% de chance de corroer a defesa em 15%: 30% de chance de corroer la defensa en 15% por 3 turnos
es.30% de chance de corroer defesa com a en: 30% de chance de corroer defensa con la energía inestable del receptáculo
es.30% de chance de drenar energia reduzind: 30% de chance de drenar energía reduciendo recuperación de stamina
es.30% de chance de não gastar stamina com: 30% de chance de no gastar stamina con skills.
es.30% de chance de quebrar combos com cont: 30% de chance de romper combos con contramedida de emboscada
es.30% de chance de quebrar combos com supr: 30% de chance de romper combos con supresión de energía
es.30% de chance de reduzir esquiva com cam: 30% de chance de reducir esquiva con campo de presión maldita
es.30% de chance de reduzir esquiva em 20%: 30% de chance de reducir esquiva en 20%

es.Cortes semicirculares surgem de alturas: Cortes semicirculares surgen desde distintas alturas. Si el objetivo está Perdido, ignora 35% de la defensa; si hay 4+ Capa, crea una Hoja Fantasma que suma 22% del daño causado.
es.Cospe um óleo grudento que reduz a agili: Escupe un aceite pegajoso que reduce la agilidad y aturde a los enemigos golpeados.
es.Cospe uma gigantesca bola de fogo que ca: Escupe una gigantesca bola de fuego que calcina el área. Causa Quemadura estándar al objetivo.
es.Costura o alvo com fios de sangue solidi: Cose al objetivo con hilos de sangre solidificada. Aplica contención, Hemorragia adicional y abre brechas en la defensa enemiga.
es.Crava um prego na efígie e bate com o ma: Clava un clavo en la efigie y golpea con el martillo, transmitiendo daño maldito al objetivo.
es.Cria armadura de ouro com HP alto, reduç: Crea armadura de oro con HP alto, reducción superior y costo de mantenimiento eficiente.
es.Cria dezenas de esferas negras magnética: Crea decenas de esferas negras magnéticas, atrayendo la tierra para formar meteoros que caen sobre el campo de batalla.
es.Cria ilusões com seu sangue que confunde: Crea ilusiones con su sangre que confunden y atacan al objetivo simultáneamente.
es.Cria lótus de gelo perfurantes. Ignora p: Crea lotos de hielo perforantes. Ignora parte de la defensa mágica del objetivo.
es.Cria transfigurações menores que persegu: Crea transfiguraciones menores que persiguen a múltiples objetivos.
es.Cria um Rasengan massivo e o esmaga cont: Crea un Rasengan masivo y lo aplasta contra el suelo, golpeando a todos los enemigos en un área grande.
es.Cria um campo de contenção anatômica de: Crea un campo de contención anatómica de 4 cargas. Cada golpe recibido es absorbido y convertido en curación: +40 HP por golpe absorbido. Acumula 1 Carga de Curación. En raids: al activarlo, todos los aliados son curados en 25% del HP máximo.
es.Cria um campo magnético que puxa armas,: Crea un campo magnético que atrae armas, reduce la precisión enemiga y aumenta la perforación de la arena de hierro.
es.Cria um clone que reflete o poder do usu: Crea un clon que refleja el poder del usuario para un ataque extra.
es.Cria um lobo elétrico gigante que perseg: Crea un lobo eléctrico gigante que persigue y golpea a los enemigos, aplicando daños continuos.
es.Cria um mini-clone de gelo que repete o: Crea un mini clon de hielo que repite el ataque en el mismo turno, causando 50% más de daño.
es.Cria um pesadelo vívido que corrói a men: Crea una pesadilla vívida que corroe la mente y el cuerpo simultáneamente.
es.Cria um redemoinho devastador. Causa +45: Crea un remolino devastador. Causa +45% daño extra por cada stack de AHOGAMIENTO en el objetivo. Inmoviliza por 1 turnos si el objetivo tiene 2+ stacks.
es.Cria um sol em miniatura na palma da mão: Crea un sol en miniatura en la palma de la mano y lo lanza contra el oponente, incinerándolo todo.
es.Cria uma armadura de areia com HP própri: Crea una armadura de arena con HP propio, consumo por turno y reducción de daño recibido mientras dure.

es.Cria uma enorme esfera de nuvens de temp: Crea una enorme esfera de nubes de tormenta cargada de electricidad, lanzándola sobre el objetivo.
es.Cria uma gigantesca lâmina de terra que: Crea una gigantesca hoja de tierra que emerge del suelo.

es.Cristal que canaliza energia elementar p: Cristal que canaliza energía elemental para aumentar el poder.
es.Reconstrução celular imediata de qualque: Reconstrucción celular inmediata de cualquier miembro o herida grave.
es.Reescreve a assinatura da alma para adap: Reescribe la firma del alma para adaptar la función en batalla.

es.Reflete 10% do dano tomado para o oponen: Refleja 10% del daño recibido al oponente si sufre un crítico.
es.Reflete 15 de dano com barreira de contr: Refleja 15 de daño con barrera de contramedida maldita
es.Reflete 20 de dano com barreira de maldi: Refleja 20 de daño con barrera de maldición sombría
es.Reforça a perna com energia amaldiçoada: Refuerza la pierna con energía maldita y aplica una patada poderosa.
es.Reforça o corpo, aumentando o dano geral: Refuerza el cuerpo, aumentando el daño general (pasiva aplicable al activar)

es.Regenera 4% do HP máximo a cada fim de t: Regenera 4% del HP máximo al final de cada turno.

es.Remolda parte do próprio corpo para cria: Remolda parte del propio cuerpo para crear un ataque traicionero.

es.Repele tudo ao redor. (Caminho Deva): Repele todo a su alrededor. (Camino Deva)
es.Replica a última técnica observada e con: Replica la última técnica observada y convierte Ecos en daño adicional con penetración parcial.
es.Requer 50+ medo e 2+ clones ativos. Fund: Requiere 50+ miedo y 2+ clones activos. Fusiona todos los clones en Zohakuten (120% HP del usuario, 80% ATQ, 6 turnos). Causa 450 de daño en el turno de la fusión y Zohakuten ataca automáticamente cada turno.
